items.answer: Is it because of kidney problem that I have burning sensation in my urethra ?

prompt.content: Generate a one sentence summary of this patient-doctor conversation.

Patient: sir, iam 38y old female.i got uti before 1mon.dr prescribe culture. e-coli org seen.i lltake 10days antibiotic course.but no improvement.atpresent i consult MD DGO,she advise citralkasyp,nitrofurantion 100 10days.atpresent i ll taking 5 days.but burning sensation in my urethra .is it kidney problem sir .i am worried ,pls help. Doctor: Hi dear Welcome to HealthcareMagic. Your doctor has prescribed you a good combination of drugs in treatment of UTI.If you can get an ultrasound done to see kidneys , it can be told about the kidney involvement.Its not suggestive that infection is in kidney just because its taking lung to be treated.Symptoms like back pain , intermittent abdominal pain suggest of kidney involvement.Please drink lots of water(upto 5 liters) to fasten the improvement.Please follow the same treatment.  Take care.
